exposure: chromosomal abnormalities (whole-chromosome aneuploidy, segmental abnormality, mosaicism)
cohort: The study participants were patients who underwent preimplantation genetic testing for monogenic disorders (PGT-Ms) without aneuploidy screening.
finding: The rate of chromosomal abnormalities was significantly greater in embryos resulting in miscarriages (53.6%) compared to those resulting in live births (14.3%) (P < 0.001).
